( Reaffirmed 2003 ) 

Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS FOR 

MODULAR UNITS FOR MACHINE TOOL 

CONSTRUCTION - MULTI-SPINDLE HEADS - CASING 

AND INPUT DRIVE SHAFT DIMENSIONS 



1- Scope — Specifies a range of basic dimensions for muiti-spindle head casings. It also prescribes 
dimensions for the interchangeability of multi-spindle head input drive shafts with motor coupling. 

2. Nominal Sizes — The nominal size of a muiti-spindle head unit shall be given by the nominal 
width of the saddle on the related slide unit ( see IS : 9722-1981 ' Dimensions for modular units for 
machine tool construction — slide units ' ). 

3. Dimensions 

3.1 Range of basic dimensions for multi-spindie head casing — As specified in Table 1 . 
3-2 Dimensions for input drive shaft — As specified in Table 2. 

4. A typical application example for the machine tool has been given in Appendix A. 

5. Designation — A multi-spindle head unit of nominal size 250, width 320 and height 250 shall be 
designated as: 

Multi-Spindle Head Unit 250 X 320 X 250 IS : 9723 

5.1 An input drive shaft of type 500 shall be designated as: 

Input Drive Shaft 500 IS : 9723 



EXPLANATORY N OTE 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following standards: 

ISO 2912-1973 ' Modular units for machine tool construction — Multi-spindle heads — Casing 
and input drive shaft dimensions * 

DIN 69621-1979 ' Machine tools; modular units; muiti-spindle heads for headstocks according 
to DIN 69611: connecting dimensions. '
